+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""Native HF -> Megatron-Core loader for thinkingmachines/Inkling (``inkling_mm_model``).
+
+The text backbone (``model.llm.*``) and the multi-token-prediction head (``model.mtp.*``, in
+``mtp.safetensors``: transformers ignores it, so it is read here directly when the index does not
+list it) are mapped; the audio / vision towers are out of scope and skipped. The model is Primus' ``InklingModel``
+(``model_type: inkling``), built by :func:`build_model`.
+
+Mapping (HF checkpoint key -> InklingModel parameter):
+
+    model.llm.embed.weight                 -> embedding.word_embeddings.weight (vocab padded)
+    model.llm.embed_norm.weight            -> embed_norm.weight
+    model.llm.norm.weight                  -> decoder.final_layernorm.weight
+    model.llm.unembed.weight               -> output_layer.weight (vocab padded)
+    layers.L.attn_norm / mlp_norm          -> input_layernorm / pre_mlp_layernorm
+    layers.L.attn.w{q_du,k_dv,v_dv,o_ud,r_du} -> self_attention.{q,k,v,o,r}_proj
+    layers.L.attn.{q,k}_norm               -> self_attention.{q,k}_norm
+    layers.L.attn.{k,v}_sconv [c,1,k]      -> self_attention.{k,v}_sconv.weight [c,k]
+    layers.L.attn.rel_logits_proj.proj     -> self_attention.rel_proj
+    layers.L.{attn,mlp}_sconv              -> {attn,mlp}_sconv.weight
+    layers.L.mlp.gate.{weight,bias,global_scale} -> mlp.gate.{weight,expert_bias,global_scale}
+    layers.L.mlp.experts.w13_weight        -> mlp.gate_up_proj (gate/up de-interleaved, as HF's Interleave op)
+    layers.L.mlp.experts.w2_weight         -> mlp.down_proj
+    layers.L.mlp.shared_experts.shared_w13_weight -> mlp.shared_gate_up_proj (de-interleaved)
+    layers.L.mlp.shared_experts.shared_w2_weight  -> mlp.shared_down_proj
+
+MTP depth D (HF ``model.mtp.layers.D.`` -> ``mtp.layers.D.``):
+
+    embed_norm / hidden_norm               -> enorm / hnorm
+    input_proj [h, 2h]                     -> eh_proj (as is: InklingMTPLayer concatenates
+                                              hidden first, as HF / SGLang)
+    transformer_block.*                    -> mtp_model_layer.* (the decoder-layer mapping above,
+                                              for the attention, norms and short convs)
+    transformer_block.mlp.w13_dn           -> mtp_model_layer.mlp.linear_fc1.weight (de-interleaved)
+    transformer_block.mlp.w2_md            -> mtp_model_layer.mlp.linear_fc2.weight
+    transformer_block.mlp.global_scale     -> mtp_model_layer.mlp.global_scale
+"""
+
+import dataclasses
+import os
+import re
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.checkpoint import native_convert_common as common
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_transformer_config import (
+    INKLING_DEFAULT_INIT_SEED,
+    InklingTransformerConfig,
+)
+from primus.core.utils.import_utils import get_model_provider
+
+PREFIX = "model.llm."
+MTP_PREFIX = "model.mtp.layers."
+MTP_FILE = "mtp.safetensors"
+# A decoder-layer key; group 1 is the 0-based layer index.
+_LAYER_KEY_RE = re.compile(re.escape(PREFIX) + r"layers\.(\d+)\.")
+# Checkpoint parts this port does not build (the audio / vision towers; it ports the text
+# backbone and the MTP depths). Their keys are
+# marked consumed-as-skipped, by name, so the completeness check still catches any *llm* key
+# that is left unmapped.
+SKIPPED_PREFIXES = ("model.audio.", "model.visual.", "model.vision_tower.")
+# MTP depth keys; group 1 is the depth.
+_MTP_KEY_RE = re.compile(re.escape(MTP_PREFIX) + r"(\d+)\.")
+
+
+def _text(cfg):
+    return cfg.get("text_config", cfg)
+
+
+# HF text_config keys the port needs; a missing one is an error (no silent fallback).
+REQUIRED_KEYS = (
+    "hidden_size",
+    "num_attention_heads",
+    "num_hidden_layers",
+    "num_key_value_heads",
+    "head_dim",
+    "rms_norm_eps",
+    "intermediate_size",
+    "n_routed_experts",
+    "n_shared_experts",
+    "num_experts_per_tok",
+    "route_scale",
+    "dense_mlp_idx",
+    "d_rel",
+    "rel_extent",
+    "sliding_window_size",
+    "local_layer_ids",
+    "swa_num_attention_heads",
+    "swa_num_key_value_heads",
+    "swa_head_dim",
+    "log_scaling_n_floor",
+    "log_scaling_alpha",
+    "sconv_kernel_size",
+    "use_embed_norm",
+    "logits_mup_width_multiplier",
+    "unpadded_vocab_size",
+    "dense_intermediate_size",
+)
+# Variant switches and the only values this port implements; any other stated value raises ValueError.
+SUPPORTED_VALUES = {
+    "dense_mlp_idx": (0,),
+    "attention_bias": (False,),
+    "tie_word_embeddings": (False,),
+    "final_logit_softcapping": (None,),
+    "gate_activation": ("sigmoid",),
+    "use_sconv": (True,),
+    "shared_expert_sink": (True,),
+    "use_gate_bias": (True,),
+    "use_global_scale": (True,),
+    "mtp_chain_hidden_post_norm": (False,),
+    "norm_after_topk": (True,),
+    "q_bias": (False,),
+    "o_bias": (False,),
+}
+
+
+def _mtp_fields(cfg):
+    """MTP fields from the top-level ``mtp_config`` (HF ``InklingMMConfig``; SGLang canonicalizes
+    the same keys onto ``text_config.mtp_*``, also accepted). No ``mtp_config``: no MTP."""
+    t = _text(cfg)
+    mc = cfg.get("mtp_config") or {}
+    depths = mc.get("num_nextn_predict_layers", mc.get("n_layers", t.get("num_nextn_predict_layers")))
+    chain = mc.get("chain_hidden_post_norm", t.get("mtp_chain_hidden_post_norm", False))
+    if chain not in (False, None):
+        raise ValueError("inkling converter: mtp chain_hidden_post_norm=True is not supported")
+    depths = int(depths or 0)
+    local_ids = mc.get("local_layer_ids", t.get("mtp_local_layer_ids")) or []
+    local_ids = [int(i) for i in local_ids]
+    if any(not 0 <= i < depths for i in local_ids):
+        raise ValueError(f"inkling converter: mtp local_layer_ids {local_ids} outside [0, {depths})")
+    extent = mc.get("local_extent", t.get("mtp_local_extent"))
+    # SGLang refuses MTP sliding kv heads / head dim other than the trunk's sliding layers'
+    for k in ("mtp_swa_num_key_value_heads", "mtp_swa_head_dim"):
+        base = t[k.replace("mtp_", "", 1)]
+        if t.get(k) not in (None, base):
+            raise ValueError(f"inkling converter: {k}={t[k]} differs from the trunk's {base}")
+    return dict(
+        mtp_num_layers=depths or None,
+        inkling_mtp_local_layer_ids=local_ids,
+        inkling_mtp_local_extent=None if extent is None else int(extent),
+        inkling_mtp_swa_num_attention_heads=t.get("mtp_swa_num_attention_heads"),
+        inkling_mtp_chain_hidden_post_norm=False,
+    )
+
+
+def derive_megatron_fields(cfg):
+    """Translate the Inkling HF config (``text_config``) into Megatron arg values.
+
+    The standard fields describe the global (full-attention) layers; the sliding
+    layers' shapes and every Inkling-only knob go in ``inkling_*``. Every needed key
+    must be present (``REQUIRED_KEYS``) and every variant switch must hold a value the
+    port implements (``SUPPORTED_VALUES``): anything else raises ``ValueError``.
+    """
+    t = _text(cfg)
+    missing = [k for k in REQUIRED_KEYS if k not in t]
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError(f"inkling converter: HF text_config lacks {missing}")
+    # A variant key the config does not state takes the value HF's InklingConfig / modeling code
+    # uses when it is absent (embed / unembed are separate tensors, the projections have no bias),
+    # which is the first entry of SUPPORTED_VALUES; a stated value must be a supported one.
+    unsupported = {k: t[k] for k, ok in SUPPORTED_VALUES.items() if k in t and t[k] not in ok}
+    if unsupported:
+        raise ValueError(f"inkling converter: unsupported Inkling variant {unsupported}")
+    nl = t["num_hidden_layers"]
+    local_ids = [int(i) for i in t["local_layer_ids"]]
+    if any(not 0 <= i < nl for i in local_ids):
+        raise ValueError(f"inkling converter: local_layer_ids {local_ids} outside [0, {nl})")
+    moe_inter = t["intermediate_size"]
+    # context length: HF's InklingConfig maps ``model_max_length`` to max_position_embeddings
+    # (a key that is present but null counts as absent)
+    max_pos = t.get("max_position_embeddings")
+    if max_pos is None:
+        max_pos = t.get("model_max_length")
+    if max_pos is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "inkling converter: HF text_config states neither max_position_embeddings nor model_max_length"
+        )
+    if "rope_theta" in t or "rope_scaling" in t or "rope_parameters" in t:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "inkling converter: the config states RoPE settings, but Inkling has no rotary embedding"
+        )
+    return dict(
+        hidden_size=t["hidden_size"],
+        num_attention_heads=t["num_attention_heads"],
+        num_layers=nl,
+        max_position_embeddings=int(max_pos),
+        norm_epsilon=t["rms_norm_eps"],
+        untie_embeddings_and_output_weights=True,  # tie_word_embeddings=True is refused above
+        ffn_hidden_size=moe_inter,
+        num_query_groups=t["num_key_value_heads"],
+        kv_channels=t["head_dim"],
+        add_qkv_bias=False,  # attention_bias=True is refused above
+        # ---- MoE (standard Megatron fields) ----
+        num_experts=t["n_routed_experts"],
+        moe_router_topk=t["num_experts_per_tok"],
+        moe_ffn_hidden_size=moe_inter,
+        # ---- Inkling-only ----
+        inkling_num_shared_experts=t["n_shared_experts"],
+        inkling_route_scale=float(t["route_scale"]),
+        inkling_dense_mlp_idx=int(t["dense_mlp_idx"]),
+        inkling_d_rel=t["d_rel"],
+        inkling_rel_extent=t["rel_extent"],
+        inkling_sliding_window=t["sliding_window_size"],
+        inkling_local_layer_ids=local_ids,
+        inkling_swa_num_attention_heads=t["swa_num_attention_heads"],
+        inkling_swa_num_query_groups=t["swa_num_key_value_heads"],
+        inkling_swa_kv_channels=t["swa_head_dim"],
+        inkling_log_scaling_n_floor=t["log_scaling_n_floor"],
+        inkling_log_scaling_alpha=float(t["log_scaling_alpha"]),
+        inkling_sconv_kernel_size=t["sconv_kernel_size"],
+        inkling_use_embed_norm=bool(t["use_embed_norm"]),
+        inkling_logits_mup_width_multiplier=float(t["logits_mup_width_multiplier"]),
+        inkling_unpadded_vocab_size=t["unpadded_vocab_size"],
+        # ---- MTP (dense SwiGLU MLP in each depth) ----
+        inkling_dense_intermediate_size=int(t["dense_intermediate_size"]),
+        inkling_dense_use_global_scale=bool(t.get("use_global_scale", True)),
+        **_mtp_fields(cfg),
+    )
+
+
+def _init_seed(args):
+    """The init seed only seeds weights the checkpoint then overwrites; take the caller's (``seed``) if
+    given (0 is a valid seed), else the config default."""
+    seed = getattr(args, "seed", None)
+    return INKLING_DEFAULT_INIT_SEED if seed is None else int(seed)
+
+
+# Every inkling_* field of the config comes from the HF config except inkling_init_seed (the
+# caller's seed), inkling_ignored_label_id (a training policy) and the kernel switches
+# (inkling_sconv_impl, inkling_attention_impl: numerically close either way), all set by build_margs. The list
+# is derived, so a new config field cannot be silently missed.
+INKLING_RUNTIME_KEYS = (
+    "inkling_init_seed",
+    "inkling_ignored_label_id",
+    "inkling_sconv_impl",
+    "inkling_attention_impl",
+)
+INKLING_KEYS = [
+    f.name
+    for f in dataclasses.fields(InklingTransformerConfig)
+    if f.name.startswith("inkling_") and f.name not in INKLING_RUNTIME_KEYS
+]
+_INKLING_DEFAULTS = {f.name: f.default for f in dataclasses.fields(InklingTransformerConfig)}
+
+
+PARAMS_DTYPES = {"bf16": torch.bfloat16, "fp16": torch.float16, "fp32": torch.float32}
+
+
+def _params_dtype(dtype):
+    """The checkpoint dtype for ``--dtype``; anything else is refused (no silent fp32 fallback)."""
+    if dtype not in PARAMS_DTYPES:
+        choices = ", ".join(repr(k) for k in sorted(PARAMS_DTYPES))
+        raise ValueError(f"inkling converter: dtype {dtype!r} is not one of {choices}")
+    return PARAMS_DTYPES[dtype]
+
+
+def build_margs(cfg_fields, args):
+    """Megatron args for the single-process conversion.
+
+    The converter writes one unsharded (TP = PP = EP = ETP = 1) legacy ``torch`` checkpoint
+    (``mp_rank_00``). Megatron does *not* reshard a legacy checkpoint at load: train with
+    TP = PP = EP = ETP = 1 (the stacked expert tensors are saved whole, not split per EP rank), or
+    first re-save the checkpoint as ``torch_dist`` with a TP = PP = EP = ETP = 1 run and load that
+    one with the training layout. Other conversion sizes are refused here.
+    """
+    import argparse
+
+    sizes = (args.tensor_parallel_size, args.pipeline_parallel_size, args.expert_parallel_size)
+    if sizes != (1, 1, 1):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "inkling converter: writes an unsharded legacy checkpoint only (TP=PP=EP=1), "
+            f"got TP/PP/EP={sizes}. "
+            "Megatron cannot reshard a legacy torch checkpoint at load: convert with TP=PP=EP=1 and train "
+            "with TP=PP=EP=1, or re-save it as torch_dist from such a run before changing TP/PP/EP"
+        )
+
+    params_dtype = _params_dtype(args.dtype)  # refuse an unknown dtype before any other work
+
+    from megatron.training.arguments import add_megatron_arguments, validate_args
+
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
+    p = add_megatron_arguments(p)
+    m = p.parse_args([])
+
+    m.hidden_size = cfg_fields["hidden_size"]
+    m.num_attention_heads = cfg_fields["num_attention_heads"]
+    m.num_layers = cfg_fields["num_layers"]
+    m.norm_epsilon = cfg_fields["norm_epsilon"]
+    m.layernorm_epsilon = cfg_fields["norm_epsilon"]  # upstream dest of --norm-epsilon
+    m.ffn_hidden_size = cfg_fields["ffn_hidden_size"]
+    m.untie_embeddings_and_output_weights = cfg_fields["untie_embeddings_and_output_weights"]
+    m.max_position_embeddings = max(cfg_fields["max_position_embeddings"], args.seq_length)
+    m.seq_length = args.seq_length
+    m.group_query_attention = True
+    m.num_query_groups = cfg_fields["num_query_groups"]
+    m.kv_channels = cfg_fields["kv_channels"]
+    m.qk_layernorm = False  # Inkling's per-head q/k RMSNorm lives in InklingAttention
+    m.normalization = "RMSNorm"
+    m.swiglu = True
+    m.add_bias_linear = False
+    m.add_qkv_bias = cfg_fields["add_qkv_bias"]
+    m.position_embedding_type = "none"  # Inkling has no rotary embedding (relative-position bias instead)
+    m.apply_rope_fusion = False
+
+    m.num_experts = cfg_fields["num_experts"]
+    m.moe_router_topk = cfg_fields["moe_router_topk"]
+    m.moe_ffn_hidden_size = cfg_fields["moe_ffn_hidden_size"]
+    m.moe_grouped_gemm = False
+    m.moe_router_load_balancing_type = "none"  # InklingMoE refuses aux losses
+    m.moe_aux_loss_coeff = 0.0
+    m.moe_router_score_function = "sigmoid"
+    for k in INKLING_KEYS:
+        setattr(m, k, cfg_fields[k])
+    m.mtp_num_layers = cfg_fields["mtp_num_layers"]
+    m.inkling_init_seed = _init_seed(args)
+    m.inkling_ignored_label_id = None  # a real (HF) tokenizer: a label past the HF vocab is a bug
+    # kernel switches: the config defaults (fused short conv when causal_conv1d imports, eager
+    # attention); the caller's args may override them
+    for k in ("inkling_sconv_impl", "inkling_attention_impl"):
+        setattr(m, k, getattr(args, k, None) or _INKLING_DEFAULTS[k])
+
+    m.vocab_size = None
+    m.make_vocab_size_divisible_by = args.make_vocab_size_divisible_by
+    m.tokenizer_type = "HuggingFaceTokenizer"
+    m.tokenizer_model = args.hf_dir
+    m.trust_remote_code = False
+
+    m.micro_batch_size = 1
+    m.global_batch_size = 1
+    m.train_iters = 1
+
+    m.tensor_model_parallel_size = 1  # the only layout the converter writes (refused above otherwise)
+    m.pipeline_model_parallel_size = 1
+    m.expert_model_parallel_size = 1
+    m.expert_tensor_parallel_size = 1
+    m.context_parallel_size = 1
+    m.sequence_parallel = False
+    m.world_size = 1
+    m.rank = 0
+    m.params_dtype = params_dtype
+    m.bf16 = args.dtype == "bf16"
+    m.fp16 = args.dtype == "fp16"
+    m.use_cpu_initialization = True
+    m.perform_initialization = False
+    m.transformer_impl = "local"
+    m.gradient_accumulation_fusion = False
+    m.async_tensor_model_parallel_allreduce = False
+    m.bias_gelu_fusion = False
+    m.bias_swiglu_fusion = False
+    m.masked_softmax_fusion = False
+    m.bias_dropout_fusion = False
+    m.apply_query_key_layer_scaling = False
+    m.attention_dropout = 0.0
+    m.hidden_dropout = 0.0
+
+    m.save = args.save_dir
+    m.ckpt_format = "torch"
+    m.no_save_optim = True
+    m.no_save_rng = True
+    m.no_load_optim = True
+    m.no_load_rng = True
+    m.save_interval = 1
+    m.async_save = False
+    m.ckpt_assume_constant_structure = False
+    m.iteration = 1
+
+    m = validate_args(m)
+    m.iteration = 1
+    return m
+
+
+def build_model(margs):
+    """Build Primus' InklingModel (``model_type: inkling``) on the current device.
+
+    ``build_model(margs)`` is the native-converter hook signature (callers that build a port's own
+    model pass the Megatron args); the provider reads the same args from Megatron's globals, which
+    ``init_megatron_single_process`` installed, so ``margs`` itself is not read here."""
+    del margs
+
+    provider = get_model_provider(model_type="inkling")
+    return provider(pre_process=True, post_process=True)
+
+
+def deinterleave(t, dim):
+    """HF ``Interleave(dim)``: rows stored as (gate0, up0, gate1, up1, ...) -> (gate..., up...)."""
+    n = t.shape[dim]
+    shape = list(t.shape)
+    t = t.reshape(*shape[:dim], n // 2, 2, *shape[dim + 1 :]).transpose(dim, dim + 1)
+    return t.reshape(shape).contiguous()
+
+
+def _place(sd: "_PlacingDict", msd, prefix=""):
+    """Copy each mapped tensor under ``prefix`` straight into the model's own storage and hand back
+    that storage (frees the checkpoint copies layer by layer; the caller's load_state_dict is then a
+    self-copy, so no second full-size copy of the weights is held). Only the keys added since the
+    last call are scanned (``sd`` is a ``_PlacingDict``), so placing layer by layer stays linear in
+    the number of layers. A key the model does not have is left for load_state_dict to report; a
+    key the model has with another shape is refused."""
+    new = sd.take_new(prefix)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for k in new:
+            v = sd[k]
+            if k not in msd:
+                continue
+            if tuple(msd[k].shape) != tuple(v.shape):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"inkling converter: {k} has shape {tuple(v.shape)}, model expects "
+                    f"{tuple(msd[k].shape)}"
+                )
+            msd[k].copy_(v)
+            dict.__setitem__(sd, k, msd[k])
+
+
+class _PlacingDict(dict):
+    """The mapped state dict: remembers the keys set since ``_place`` last took them."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self._new = {}
+
+    def __setitem__(self, k, v):
+        super().__setitem__(k, v)
+        self._new[k] = None
+
+    def take_new(self, prefix=""):
+        taken = [k for k in self._new if k.startswith(prefix)]
+        for k in taken:
+            del self._new[k]
+        return taken
+
+
+def _map_inkling_block(sd, get, h, p):
+    """One Inkling block's attention, norms and short convs: HF ``h`` (``attn.*``, ``attn_norm``,
+    ``mlp_norm``, ``attn_sconv``, ``mlp_sconv``) -> Megatron ``p``. Shared by the decoder layers
+    and the MTP depths' ``transformer_block`` so the two mappings cannot drift. ``get(name,
+    dtype=None)`` reads (and marks consumed) one HF tensor; the MLP is mapped by the caller (MoE
+    in the decoder, dense in MTP)."""
+    a, pa = h + "attn.", p + "self_attention."
+    sd[p + "input_layernorm.weight"] = get(h + "attn_norm.weight")
+    sd[p + "pre_mlp_layernorm.weight"] = get(h + "mlp_norm.weight")
+    sd[p + "attn_sconv.weight"] = get(h + "attn_sconv.weight", torch.float32).squeeze(1)
+    sd[p + "mlp_sconv.weight"] = get(h + "mlp_sconv.weight", torch.float32).squeeze(1)
+    for src, dst in (
+        ("wq_du", "q_proj"),
+        ("wk_dv", "k_proj"),
+        ("wv_dv", "v_proj"),
+        ("wo_ud", "o_proj"),
+        ("wr_du", "r_proj"),
+    ):
+        sd[pa + dst + ".weight"] = get(a + src + ".weight")
+    sd[pa + "q_norm.weight"] = get(a + "q_norm.weight")
+    sd[pa + "k_norm.weight"] = get(a + "k_norm.weight")
+    sd[pa + "k_sconv.weight"] = get(a + "k_sconv.weight", torch.float32).squeeze(1)
+    sd[pa + "v_sconv.weight"] = get(a + "v_sconv.weight", torch.float32).squeeze(1)
+    sd[pa + "rel_proj"] = get(a + "rel_logits_proj.proj")
+
+
+def build_mcore_state_dict(model, store, margs, cfg_fields, log, allow_truncated=True):
+    """HF tensors -> the Megatron state dict of ``model`` (HF layer L -> ``decoder.layers.L``).
+
+    The checkpoint's layer indices must be contiguous from 0. A model with more layers than the
+    checkpoint is refused. A model with fewer layers (a truncated proxy, built by tests and the
+    parity tooling) is mapped with a WARNING when ``allow_truncated``; ``convert`` passes
+    ``allow_truncated=False``, so a conversion that would save fewer layers than the checkpoint
+    (for example, a wrong ``num_hidden_layers``) fails."""
+    dtype = margs.params_dtype
+    msd = model.state_dict()
+    padded_vocab = msd["embedding.word_embeddings.weight"].shape[0]
+    sd, consumed = _PlacingDict(), set()  # _place scans only the keys added since its last call
+
+    def get(name, dt=None):
+        consumed.add(PREFIX + name)
+        return store.get(PREFIX + name, dt or dtype)
+
+    sd["embedding.word_embeddings.weight"] = common.pad_vocab(get("embed.weight"), padded_vocab)
+    # Mapped by the use_embed_norm flag, read off the built model (InklingModel builds embed_norm
+    # iff config.inkling_use_embed_norm), not by what the checkpoint happens to hold; a clear
+    # error when the two disagree.
+    has_embed_norm = store.has(PREFIX + "embed_norm.weight")
+    if "embed_norm.weight" in msd:
+        if not has_embed_norm:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"the model uses embed_norm (use_embed_norm: true) but the checkpoint has no {PREFIX}embed_norm.weight"
+            )
+        sd["embed_norm.weight"] = get("embed_norm.weight")
+    elif has_embed_norm:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"the model has no embed_norm (use_embed_norm: false) but the checkpoint has {PREFIX}embed_norm.weight"
+        )
+    sd["decoder.final_layernorm.weight"] = get("norm.weight")
+    sd["output_layer.weight"] = common.pad_vocab(get("unembed.weight"), padded_vocab)
+
+    indices = sorted({int(m.group(1)) for m in map(_LAYER_KEY_RE.match, store.all_keys()) if m})
+    hf_layers = len(indices)
+    if indices != list(range(hf_layers)):
+        gaps = sorted(set(range(indices[-1] + 1)) - set(indices))
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"inkling converter: the checkpoint's layers are not contiguous (missing layer(s) {gaps}; "
+            "a shard may be missing)"
+        )
+    if margs.num_layers > hf_layers:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"inkling converter: the model builds {margs.num_layers} layers, the checkpoint has {hf_layers}"
+        )
+    if margs.num_layers < hf_layers:
+        if not allow_truncated:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"inkling converter: the model builds {margs.num_layers} layers but the checkpoint has "
+                f"{hf_layers}; a conversion must cover every layer (check num_hidden_layers in config.json)"
+            )
+        log(
+            f"inkling: WARNING: truncated proxy: building HF layers 0..{margs.num_layers - 1} of "
+            f"{hf_layers} (no layer offset); layers {margs.num_layers}.. are not loaded"
+        )
+    # HF layer L -> decoder.layers.L: the model is always built whole (first layer is HF layer 0).
+    for L in range(margs.num_layers):
+        h, p = f"layers.{L}.", f"decoder.layers.{L}."
+        _map_inkling_block(sd, get, h, p)
+
+        g, pm = h + "mlp.", p + "mlp."
+        sd[pm + "gate.weight"] = get(g + "gate.weight")
+        sd[pm + "gate.global_scale"] = get(g + "gate.global_scale", torch.float32).reshape(1).to(dtype)
+        sd[pm + "gate.expert_bias"] = get(g + "gate.bias", torch.float32)
+        # EP = 1 (build_margs): all experts are local
+        sd[pm + "gate_up_proj"] = deinterleave(get(g + "experts.w13_weight"), 1)
+        sd[pm + "down_proj"] = get(g + "experts.w2_weight")
+        sd[pm + "shared_gate_up_proj"] = deinterleave(get(g + "shared_experts.shared_w13_weight"), 1)
+        sd[pm + "shared_down_proj"] = get(g + "shared_experts.shared_w2_weight")
+        _place(sd, msd, p)
+
+    _map_mtp(sd, msd, store, consumed, margs, log)
+    _skip(store, consumed, margs, log)
+    return _finish(sd, msd, consumed, cfg_fields, margs, log)
+
+
+class MTPStore:
+    """``store`` plus ``<hf_dir>/mtp.safetensors`` when the checkpoint index does not list it
+    (transformers ignores the MTP file, so an index written by it may omit its keys). The MTP
+    file's key set is read once (``safe_open.keys()`` builds a new list on each call)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, store):
+        self._store = store
+        self._extra = None
+        self._extra_keys = frozenset()
+        path = os.path.join(getattr(store, "hf_dir", "") or "", MTP_FILE)
+        if not any(k.startswith(MTP_PREFIX) for k in store.all_keys()) and os.path.isfile(path):
+            from safetensors import safe_open
+
+            self._extra = safe_open(path, framework="pt", device="cpu")
+            self._extra_keys = frozenset(self._extra.keys())
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name):
+        return getattr(self._store, name)
+
+    def all_keys(self):
+        return set(self._store.all_keys()) | self._extra_keys
+
+    def has(self, name):
+        return name in self._extra_keys or self._store.has(name)
+
+    def get(self, name, dtype=None):
+        if name in self._extra_keys:
+            t = self._extra.get_tensor(name)
+            return t.to(dtype) if dtype is not None else t
+        return self._store.get(name, dtype)
+
+
+def _map_mtp(sd, msd, store, consumed, margs, log):
+    """Map HF MTP depth D (``model.mtp.layers.D.``) to ``mtp.layers.D.`` (module docstring).
+
+    The checkpoint must hold exactly the depths the model builds when it builds any; a model
+    without MTP (``mtp_num_layers`` unset) skips the checkpoint's MTP keys with a log line."""
+    dtype = margs.params_dtype
+    depths = int(getattr(margs, "mtp_num_layers", None) or 0)
+    if not depths:
+        n = 0
+        for k in store.all_keys():
+            if k.startswith("model.mtp.") and k not in consumed:
+                consumed.add(k)
+                n += 1
+        if n:
+            log(f"inkling: skipped {n} MTP tensors (mtp_num_layers is not set)")
+        return
+    found = sorted({int(m.group(1)) for m in map(_MTP_KEY_RE.match, store.all_keys()) if m})
+    if found != list(range(depths)):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"inkling converter: the model builds MTP depths 0..{depths - 1}, the checkpoint has {found} "
+            f"(is {MTP_FILE} present?)"
+        )
+
+    def get(name, dt=None):
+        consumed.add(name)
+        return store.get(name, dt or dtype)
+
+    for d in range(depths):
+        h, p = f"{MTP_PREFIX}{d}.", f"mtp.layers.{d}."
+        sd[p + "enorm.weight"] = get(h + "embed_norm.weight")
+        sd[p + "hnorm.weight"] = get(h + "hidden_norm.weight")
+        sd[p + "eh_proj.weight"] = get(h + "input_proj.weight")
+        b, pl = h + "transformer_block.", p + "mtp_model_layer."
+        _map_inkling_block(sd, get, b, pl)
+        g, pm = b + "mlp.", pl + "mlp."
+        # HF's dense MLP stores w13 interleaved (gate rows even, up rows odd), as the experts
+        sd[pm + "linear_fc1.weight"] = deinterleave(get(g + "w13_dn.weight"), 0)
+        sd[pm + "linear_fc2.weight"] = get(g + "w2_md.weight")
+        if pm + "global_scale" in msd or store.has(g + "global_scale"):
+            sd[pm + "global_scale"] = get(g + "global_scale", torch.float32).reshape(1).to(dtype)
+        _place(sd, msd, p)
+    log(f"inkling: mapped {depths} MTP depths from model.mtp.layers.*")
+
+
+def _skip(store, consumed, margs, log):
+    """Mark the checkpoint keys this port intentionally does not map as consumed, and log them.
+
+    Skipped: the audio / vision towers (``SKIPPED_PREFIXES``), and the
+    backbone layers at or past ``margs.num_layers``. ``convert`` builds the full HF depth, so
+    there are none there. A caller that builds fewer layers builds a *truncated proxy*: the
+    model is the first ``margs.num_layers`` HF layers (``build_mcore_state_dict`` maps HF
+    layer L to ``decoder.layers.L`` with no offset, and the sliding / global layer kinds use
+    the same 0-based ids). This is not a pipeline stage: the model is always built whole
+    (``pre_process`` and ``post_process``), so a loader that wants layers ``k..`` of the HF
+    model must not use this function. Any other key stays unconsumed, and
+    ``load_validate_save`` refuses to save.
+    """
+    skipped = {}
+    for k in store.all_keys():
+        if k in consumed:
+            continue
+        part = next((p for p in SKIPPED_PREFIXES if k.startswith(p)), None)
+        if part is None:
+            mt = _LAYER_KEY_RE.match(k)
+            if mt and int(mt.group(1)) >= margs.num_layers:
+                part = f"{PREFIX}layers.>={margs.num_layers}"
+        if part is not None:
+            skipped[part] = skipped.get(part, 0) + 1
+            consumed.add(k)
+    for part, n in sorted(skipped.items()):
+        log(
+            f"inkling: skipped {n} checkpoint tensors under {part} (audio / vision tower: not part of this port)"
+        )
+
+
+def _finish(sd, msd, consumed, cfg_fields, margs, log):
+    _place(sd, msd)  # the tensors not placed per layer (embedding, final norm, output layer)
+    if cfg_fields.get("inkling_unpadded_vocab_size") is None:
+        padded = msd["output_layer.weight"].shape[0]
+        log(f"inkling: unpadded_vocab_size is null; all {padded} padded logits stay unmasked")
+    log(
+        f"inkling: mapped {len(sd)} tensors; {len(consumed)} checkpoint keys consumed "
+        f"(mapped + skipped); {margs.num_layers} decoder layers built"
+    )
+    return sd, consumed
+
+
+def convert(
+    hf_dir,
+    save_dir,
+    tensor_parallel_size=1,
+    pipeline_parallel_size=1,
+    expert_parallel_size=1,
+    dtype="bf16",
+    seq_length=4096,
+    make_vocab_size_divisible_by=128,
+    master_port=29561,
+    log=print,
+    seed=INKLING_DEFAULT_INIT_SEED,
+):
+    common.assert_bridge_free("pre-init")
+    args = SimpleNamespace(
+        hf_dir=hf_dir,
+        save_dir=save_dir,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
+        pipeline_parallel_size=pipeline_parallel_size,
+        expert_parallel_size=expert_parallel_size,
+        seq_length=seq_length,
+        make_vocab_size_divisible_by=make_vocab_size_divisible_by,
+        seed=seed,
+    )
+    cfg_fields = derive_megatron_fields(common.read_hf_config(hf_dir))
+    margs = build_margs(cfg_fields, args)
+    margs = common.init_megatron_single_process(margs, master_port, log=log)
+    model = build_model(margs)
+    store = MTPStore(common.SafetensorsStore(hf_dir))
+    sd, consumed = build_mcore_state_dict(model, store, margs, cfg_fields, log, allow_truncated=False)
+    common.load_validate_save(model, sd, consumed, store, margs, save_dir, log)
+    common.assert_bridge_free("post-save")
+    return save_dir

+"""Inkling decoder layer and block (sequence-first ``[s, b, h]``)."""
+
+from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_block import (
+    TransformerBlock,
+    TransformerBlockSubmodules,
+    get_num_layers_to_build,
+)
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_layer import (
+    TransformerLayer,
+    TransformerLayerSubmodules,
+)
+from megatron.core.utils import get_pg_rank
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.inkling.inkling_dense_mlp import (
+    InklingDenseMLP,
+)
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.inkling.inkling_layers import (
+    InklingAttention,
+    InklingRMSNorm,
+    InklingShortConv,
+)
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.inkling.inkling_moe import InklingMoE
+
+
+class InklingDecoderLayer(TransformerLayer):
+    """x + attn_sconv(attn(norm(x))); then h + mlp_sconv(moe(norm(h))).
+
+    Built by Megatron's :class:`TransformerLayer` constructor (process groups, the
+    global layer number, the cuda-graph / offload bookkeeping; FSDP2 and
+    Megatron-FSDP wrap ``TransformerLayer`` units) with identity slots, then fills
+    the slots with Inkling's modules: its layer has short convs on both residual
+    branches and no bias-dropout-add (Inkling has no hidden dropout) or
+    cross-attention.
+
+    ``layer_number`` is the 1-based index within this pipeline (virtual) stage, as
+    ``TransformerBlock`` passes it; ``self.layer_number`` is Megatron's 1-based
+    global number (distributed-checkpoint keys); ``self.layer_number - 1`` is the
+    0-based global index (``inkling_local_layer_ids`` and the init seeds).
+
+    Selective recompute follows Megatron's module names: ``core_attn`` (attention core,
+    in :class:`InklingAttention`), ``layernorm`` (both pre-norms, output-discarding as in
+    ``TransformerLayer``: the norm output is freed after its consumer ran and recomputed by a
+    gradient hook), ``moe`` (the whole MoE layer), ``moe_act`` (the expert SwiGLU) and
+    ``shared_experts`` (the shared experts), the last three in :class:`InklingMoE`. ``mlp``
+    covers the dense MLP of the MTP depths only (:class:`InklingDenseMLP`).
+
+    ``is_mtp_layer`` builds the block of a multi-token-prediction depth (Megatron passes
+    ``layer_number`` = depth + 1): the same layer with a dense SwiGLU MLP (HF / SGLang force
+    ``dense_mlp_idx`` past it) and the depth's own attention layout (sliding with the MTP window
+    for the depths in ``inkling_mtp_local_layer_ids``, else global).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config,
+        layer_number=1,
+        pg_collection=None,
+        vp_stage=None,
+        submodules=None,
+        is_mtp_layer=False,
+        **_kwargs,
+    ):
+        if pg_collection is None:
+            pg_collection = ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups()
+        if config.hidden_dropout:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Inkling has no hidden (residual) dropout: set hidden_dropout: 0.0 "
+                f"(got {config.hidden_dropout})"
+            )
+        super().__init__(
+            config=config,
+            submodules=TransformerLayerSubmodules(),
+            layer_number=layer_number,
+            pg_collection=pg_collection,
+            vp_stage=vp_stage,
+            is_mtp_layer=is_mtp_layer,
+        )
+        self.vp_stage = vp_stage
+        if is_mtp_layer:
+            # MTP depth d (``self.layer_number`` = d + 1, Megatron's MTP numbering): a dense MLP,
+            # sliding attention when d is in inkling_mtp_local_layer_ids (with the MTP window /
+            # heads), and init seeds after the decoder's (layer index num_layers + d).
+            depth = self.layer_number - 1
+            idx = config.num_layers + depth
+            sliding = depth in (config.inkling_mtp_local_layer_ids or [])
+            attn_kwargs = dict(
+                sliding_window=config.inkling_mtp_window,
+                swa_num_attention_heads=config.inkling_mtp_swa_heads,
+            )
+        else:
+            idx = self.layer_number - 1  # 0-based global layer index (local-layer ids, init seeds)
+            sliding = idx in (config.inkling_local_layer_ids or [])
+            attn_kwargs = {}
+        self.is_moe_layer = not is_mtp_layer
+        eps = config.layernorm_epsilon
+        H = config.hidden_size
+        self.input_layernorm = InklingRMSNorm(H, eps)
+        self.self_attention = InklingAttention(
+            config, self.layer_number, idx, sliding, self.pg_collection, **attn_kwargs
+        )
+        # replicated over TP: the TP group sets their checkpoint replica ids
+        tp_group = self.pg_collection.tp
+        self.attn_sconv = InklingShortConv(
+            H, config.inkling_sconv_kernel_size, tp_group=tp_group, impl=config.inkling_sconv_impl
+        )
+        self.pre_mlp_layernorm = InklingRMSNorm(H, eps)
+        if is_mtp_layer:
+            self.mlp = InklingDenseMLP(config, idx, tp_group=self.pg_collection.tp)
+        else:
+            self.mlp = InklingMoE(config, self.layer_number, idx, self.pg_collection)
+        self.mlp_sconv = InklingShortConv(
+            H, config.inkling_sconv_kernel_size, tp_group=tp_group, impl=config.inkling_sconv_impl
+        )
+        selective = config.recompute_granularity == "selective"
+        modules = set(config.recompute_modules or []) if selective else set()
+        self.recompute_norms = "layernorm" in modules
+
+    def _norm(self, norm, x):
+        """``(norm(x), checkpoint)``; with layernorm recompute (training) the checkpoint is a
+        ``CheckpointWithoutOutput`` whose output the caller discards after its consumer ran."""
+        if not (self.recompute_norms and self.training and x.requires_grad):
+            return norm(x), None
+        ckpt = tensor_parallel.CheckpointWithoutOutput(fp8=None)  # None = no fp8 (refused)
+        return ckpt.checkpoint(norm, x), ckpt
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, attention_mask=None, context=None, inference_context=None, **kwargs):
+        """Megatron's layer contract: ``(hidden_states, context)``."""
+        if inference_context is not None or kwargs.get("inference_params") is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Inkling: KV-cache inference is not supported")
+        if kwargs.get("packed_seq_params") is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Inkling: packed sequences are not supported")
+        padding_mask = kwargs.get("padding_mask")
+        x, ckpt = self._norm(self.input_layernorm, hidden_states)
+        attn, _ = self.self_attention(x, attention_mask=attention_mask)
+        if ckpt is not None:  # free the norm output; recompute it when attn's gradient arrives
+            ckpt.discard_output_and_register_recompute(attn)
+        h = hidden_states + self.attn_sconv(attn)
+        y, ckpt = self._norm(self.pre_mlp_layernorm, h)
+        moe_out, _ = self.mlp(y, padding_mask=padding_mask)  # InklingMoE refuses a mask
+        if ckpt is not None:
+            ckpt.discard_output_and_register_recompute(moe_out)
+        out = h + self.mlp_sconv(moe_out)
+        return out, context
+
+
+class InklingBlock(TransformerBlock):
+    """The Inkling decoder stack for this pipeline stage (and virtual stage).
+
+    Built by Megatron's :class:`TransformerBlock` constructor from a
+    ``TransformerBlockSubmodules`` spec: one :class:`InklingDecoderLayer` spec per
+    layer of this stage and Inkling's RMSNorm as the final norm (on the
+    post-process stage only). The forward is Megatron's: full recompute
+    (``uniform`` / ``block``, ``recompute_num_layers``), pipeline input tensors,
+    viewless outputs and the final norm all come from ``TransformerBlock.forward``.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config, pre_process=True, post_process=True, pg_collection=None, vp_stage=None):
+        if pg_collection is None:
+            pg_collection = ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups()
+        n = get_num_layers_to_build(config, vp_stage=vp_stage, pp_rank=get_pg_rank(pg_collection.pp))
+        spec = TransformerBlockSubmodules(
+            layer_specs=[ModuleSpec(module=InklingDecoderLayer)] * n, layer_norm=InklingRMSNorm
+        )
+        super().__init__(
+            config=config,
+            spec=spec,
+            post_layer_norm=True,
+            pre_process=pre_process,
+            post_process=post_process,
+            pg_collection=pg_collection,
+            vp_stage=vp_stage,
+        )
+
+    def sharded_state_dict(self, prefix="", sharded_offsets=(), metadata=None):
+        """Per-layer keys (``layers.{global}.``): sliding and global layers have different
+        shapes (KV heads, relative-bias extent), so they cannot be stacked along a layer axis."""
+        metadata = dict(metadata or {})
+        metadata["non_homogeneous_layers"] = True
+        return super().sharded_state_dict(prefix, sharded_offsets, metadata)

+"""Model provider / builder for Inkling (``model_type: inkling``)."""
+
+import dataclasses
+from typing import Optional
+
+from megatron.training import get_args, print_rank_0
+from megatron.training.arguments import core_transformer_config_from_args
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_model import InklingModel
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_transformer_config import (
+    InklingTransformerConfig,
+)
+
+
+def inkling_builder(args, pre_process, post_process, vp_stage=None, config=None, pg_collection=None):
+    print_rank_0("[Primus:Inkling] building InklingModel...")
+    if config is None:
+        config = core_transformer_config_from_args(args, config_class=InklingTransformerConfig)
+    if getattr(args, "multi_latent_attention", False):
+        raise ValueError("Inkling has its own attention: multi_latent_attention must be false")
+    if args.use_legacy_models:
+        raise ValueError("Inkling requires use_legacy_models=False (Mcore-only)")
+    if getattr(args, "reset_position_ids", False):
+        # The global-layer log scaling (tau) uses the index in the row as the position.
+        raise ValueError("Inkling does not support reset_position_ids (set reset_position_ids: false)")
+    if not isinstance(config, InklingTransformerConfig):
+        raise ValueError(f"Inkling needs an InklingTransformerConfig, got {type(config).__name__}")
+    if (
+        getattr(args, "mock_data", False)
+        and getattr(args, "tokenizer_type", None) == "NullTokenizer"
+        and config.inkling_ignored_label_id is None
+        and config.inkling_unpadded_vocab_size is not None
+        and int(args.vocab_size) >= config.inkling_unpadded_vocab_size
+    ):
+        # Mock data: the NullTokenizer EOD id (= vocab_size) is a label past the HF vocab that
+        # eod_mask_loss does not mask (it masks EOD inputs). That one id scores 0; any other
+        # label past the HF vocab still raises. A validated copy (dataclasses.replace reruns
+        # __post_init__): the caller's config, and any other model built from it, is unchanged.
+        config = dataclasses.replace(config, inkling_ignored_label_id=int(args.vocab_size))
+        print_rank_0(
+            f"[Primus:Inkling] mock data (NullTokenizer): label id {args.vocab_size} (the EOD id, "
+            "past the HF vocab) scores 0 (inkling_ignored_label_id)"
+        )
+    return InklingModel(
+        config=config,
+        vocab_size=args.padded_vocab_size,
+        max_sequence_length=args.max_position_embeddings,
+        pre_process=pre_process,
+        post_process=post_process,
+        fp16_lm_cross_entropy=args.fp16_lm_cross_entropy,
+        parallel_output=True,
+        share_embeddings_and_output_weights=not args.untie_embeddings_and_output_weights,
+        pg_collection=pg_collection,
+        vp_stage=vp_stage,
+    )
+
+
+def model_provider(
+    model_builder=None,
+    pre_process: bool = True,
+    post_process: bool = True,
+    vp_stage: Optional[int] = None,
+    config=None,
+    pg_collection=None,
+):
+    """``model_provider`` for Megatron's ``pretrain()`` (``get_model_provider`` binds the builder)."""
+    if model_builder is None:
+        model_builder = inkling_builder
+    args = get_args()
+    if args.record_memory_history:
+        import torch
+
+        torch.cuda.memory._record_memory_history(
+            True, trace_alloc_max_entries=100000, trace_alloc_record_context=True
+        )
+    return model_builder(
+        args, pre_process, post_process, vp_stage, config=config, pg_collection=pg_collection
+    )

+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""InklingModel: the thinkingmachines/Inkling text backbone on Megatron-Core.
+
+normed embedding -> InklingBlock -> final norm -> (h / logits_mup_width_multiplier) @ unembed,
+plus the multi-token-prediction depths (``mtp_num_layers``; ``inkling_mtp.py``) on the last
+pipeline stage, trained with Megatron's MTP loss. Audio / vision towers are not part of this port.
+"""
+
+import contextlib
+import weakref
+
+import torch
+from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+from megatron.core.models.common.embeddings.language_model_embedding import (
+    LanguageModelEmbedding,
+)
+from megatron.core.models.common.language_module.language_module import LanguageModule
+from megatron.core.transformer.enums import ModelType
+from megatron.core.transformer.multi_token_prediction import (
+    MultiTokenPredictionBlock,
+    mtp_on_this_rank,
+    process_mtp_loss,
+)
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_block import InklingBlock
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.inkling.inkling_layers import (
+    InklingRMSNorm,
+)
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.inkling.inkling_mtp import (
+    get_inkling_mtp_block_spec,
+)
+
+
+def _padded_label_error(count, n):
+    return ValueError(
+        f"Inkling: {count} label(s) >= inkling_unpadded_vocab_size={n} are not masked by loss_mask; "
+        "those ids do not exist in the HF vocab (tokenizer / vocab mismatch?). Mask them with loss_mask"
+    )
+
+
+_LIVE_CHECKS = weakref.WeakSet()
+_DEFER_DEPTH = 0  # > 0 inside deferring_padded_label_checks() (the patched forward-backward pass)
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def deferring_padded_label_checks():
+    """Inside it, padded-label counts are queued (CPU or GPU) for ``flush_padded_label_checks``,
+    which every rank calls at the same point (the ``megatron.inkling.padded_label_check`` patch
+    wraps each forward-backward pass in it). Outside it, a model call checks its labels at once,
+    on its own rank: nothing is queued and no collective is needed (eval scripts, converters, a
+    teacher model, any forward outside the training / eval schedule)."""
+    global _DEFER_DEPTH
+    _DEFER_DEPTH += 1
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        _DEFER_DEPTH -= 1
+
+
+def _collective_device(dist, pending):
+    """The device of the all-reduced count: the CPU on a gloo group (CPU runs, the unit tests),
+    else the device of a queued count, else the current GPU."""
+    try:
+        backend = dist.get_backend()
+    except (RuntimeError, ValueError):  # no default group (only the initialized flag is set)
+        backend = None
+    if backend == "gloo":
+        return torch.device("cpu")
+    if pending:
+        return pending[0].device
+    return torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+
+
+def flush_padded_label_checks(unpadded_vocab_size):
+    """Check every live model's pending padded-label counts, on every rank together.
+
+    ``unpadded_vocab_size`` is the run's ``inkling_unpadded_vocab_size`` (from the shared config,
+    the same on every rank). When it is ``None`` the run checks no padded labels: queued counts
+    are dropped, with no collective and no host read. Otherwise the counts queued since the last
+    flush are summed (one device read) and, with torch.distributed initialized, all-reduced over
+    the world group, so every rank raises the same ValueError (not only the last-stage rank that
+    saw the bad labels, which would leave the others waiting in their next collective). Whether a
+    rank joins the collective depends only on that argument, never on which models are alive on
+    the rank. Every rank must call it at the same point: the ``megatron.inkling.padded_label_check``
+    patch calls it after each forward-backward pass of a train step or eval step, before the
+    optimizer step."""
+    pending = [p for check in list(_LIVE_CHECKS) for p in check.take()]
+    if unpadded_vocab_size is None:
+        return
+    dist = torch.distributed
+    distributed = dist.is_available() and dist.is_initialized()
+    if not pending and not distributed:
+        return
+    device = _collective_device(dist, pending) if distributed else pending[0].device
+    total = torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    for count in pending:
+        total += count.to(device)
+    if distributed:
+        dist.all_reduce(total)
+    total = int(total)
+    if total > 0:
+        raise _padded_label_error(total, unpadded_vocab_size)
+
+
+def discard_padded_label_checks():
+    """Drop every live model's queued padded-label counts without reading them (the
+    forward-backward pass that queued them failed). Never raises: it only empties host-side
+    lists, so the caller's original exception is what propagates."""
+    for check in list(_LIVE_CHECKS):
+        check.pending = []
+
+
+class _PaddedLabelCheck:
+    """Refuses labels past the HF vocab that the loss scores.
+
+    In the patched forward-backward pass (``deferring_padded_label_checks``) the count is queued
+    without a host read, on any device: ``flush_padded_label_checks`` reads the queued counts,
+    summed over all ranks, once after the pass (one scalar all-reduce and one host read per step,
+    not per micro-batch), so a bad micro-batch fails its step on every rank together, before the
+    optimizer applies its update. A rank never raises alone inside the pass (it would leave the
+    others waiting in a collective), also on the CPU / gloo. Outside the pass the count is read at
+    once and the call raises on its own rank (ValueError)."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.pending = []  # [count tensor]: labels past the HF vocab, per call
+        _LIVE_CHECKS.add(self)
+
+    def __call__(self, scored, n):
+        if _DEFER_DEPTH > 0:
+            self.pending.append(scored.sum())
+            return
+        if bool(scored.any()):
+            raise _padded_label_error(int(scored.sum()), n)
+
+    def take(self):
+        """The queued counts, removed from the queue."""
+        out, self.pending = self.pending, []
+        return out
+
+
+class InklingModel(LanguageModule):
+    """The Inkling text backbone. ``fp16_lm_cross_entropy`` is accepted for the GPT builder
+    signature and refused if set (the loss is computed by LanguageModule in fp32)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config,

+            )
+        errors.extend(self._mtp_errors())
+        if self.num_moe_experts is None or self.moe_router_topk is None:
+            errors.append("Inkling is an MoE model: num_moe_experts and moe_router_topk are required")
+        ignored, n_vocab = self.inkling_ignored_label_id, self.inkling_unpadded_vocab_size
+        if ignored is not None and (type(ignored) is not int or n_vocab is None or ignored < n_vocab):
+            errors.append(
+                f"inkling_ignored_label_id={ignored!r} must be an int >= inkling_unpadded_vocab_size "
+                f"({n_vocab}): only an id past the HF vocab can be ignored"
+            )
+        n_floor = self.inkling_log_scaling_n_floor
+        if n_floor is not None and (not _is_number(n_floor) or n_floor <= 0):
+            errors.append(
+                f"inkling_log_scaling_n_floor={n_floor!r} must be a number > 0 (or None to disable log scaling)"
+            )
+        etp = self.expert_tensor_parallel_size
+        # The MoE is replicated over TP: every TP rank holds the same experts and computes the
+        # same expert gradients. Expert grads are reduced over the expert-data-parallel group
+        # (world / (PP * ETP * EP) ranks); only ETP = TP keeps the TP replicas out of it. With
+        # ETP < TP the replicated grads would be summed TP / ETP times too often.
+        if etp != tp:
+            errors.append(
+                f"expert_tensor_parallel_size={etp} must equal tensor_model_parallel_size={tp}: "
+                "Inkling's experts are replicated over TP (leave it unset to get ETP = TP)"
+            )
+        if self.fp8 or getattr(self, "fp4", None):
+            errors.append("fp8 / fp4 training is not supported by the Inkling layers")
+        if (
+            getattr(self, "cuda_graph_impl", "none") not in (None, "none")
+            or getattr(self, "enable_cuda_graph", False)
+            or getattr(self, "external_cuda_graph", False)
+        ):
+            errors.append("CUDA graphs are not supported by the Inkling layers")
+        # Both need Megatron's sub-module schedule (build_schedule_plan / split wgrad callables),
+        # which InklingModel and its layers do not implement.
+        for name in ("overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm", "delay_wgrad_compute"):
+            if getattr(self, name, False):
+                errors.append(f"{name} is not supported by the Inkling layers")
+        if getattr(self, "cpu_offloading", False):
+            errors.append("activation CPU offloading is not supported by the Inkling layers")
+        if errors:
+            raise ValueError("InklingTransformerConfig: " + "; ".join(errors))
+
+    # ---- MTP helpers ----
+    @property
+    def inkling_mtp_window(self):
+        """Window / relative-bias extent of the sliding MTP depths."""
+        if self.inkling_mtp_local_extent is None:
+            return self.inkling_sliding_window
+        return self.inkling_mtp_local_extent
+
+    @property
+    def inkling_mtp_swa_heads(self):
+        """Attention heads of the sliding MTP depths."""
+        if self.inkling_mtp_swa_num_attention_heads is None:
+            return self.inkling_swa_num_attention_heads
+        return self.inkling_mtp_swa_num_attention_heads
+
+    def _mtp_errors(self):
+        """Checks of the dense-MLP fields (always: the converter and FLOPs report read them) and of
+        the MTP fields (only when ``mtp_num_layers`` is set)."""
+        errors = []
+        if type(self.inkling_dense_intermediate_size) is not int or self.inkling_dense_intermediate_size <= 0:
+            errors.append(
+                f"inkling_dense_intermediate_size={self.inkling_dense_intermediate_size!r} must be a positive int"
+            )
+        depths = self.mtp_num_layers
+        if not depths:
+            return errors
+        if type(depths) is not int or depths < 1:
+            return errors + [f"mtp_num_layers={depths!r} must be a positive int"]
+        ids = list(self.inkling_mtp_local_layer_ids or [])
+        if any(type(i) is not int or i < 0 for i in ids) or len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
+            errors.append(f"inkling_mtp_local_layer_ids={ids} must be unique non-negative ints")
+        # As inkling_local_layer_ids: ids >= mtp_num_layers name depths a run with fewer depths
+        # (e.g. mtp_num_layers=1 with the release default [1]) does not build. The converter
+        # checks the ids against the checkpoint's own depth count.
+        beyond = sorted(i for i in ids if type(i) is int and i >= depths)
+        if beyond:
+            warning_rank_0(
+                f"Inkling: inkling_mtp_local_layer_ids {beyond} are >= mtp_num_layers={depths}; "
+                "those MTP depths are not built"
+            )
+        local = [i for i in ids if type(i) is int and 0 <= i < depths]
+        window = self.inkling_mtp_window
+        if type(window) is not int or window <= 0:
+            source = (
+                "inkling_mtp_local_extent"
+                if self.inkling_mtp_local_extent is not None
+                else "inkling_sliding_window (inkling_mtp_local_extent is unset)"
+            )
+            errors.append(f"the MTP sliding window {source}={window!r} must be a positive int")
+        heads = self.inkling_mtp_swa_heads
+        groups = self.inkling_swa_num_query_groups
+        if type(heads) is not int or heads <= 0:
+            errors.append(f"inkling_mtp_swa_num_attention_heads={heads!r} must be a positive int")
+        elif local and type(groups) is int and groups > 0:
+            # SGLang asserts the MTP sliding K / V heads and head dim equal the trunk's
+            if heads % groups or heads % self.tensor_model_parallel_size:
+                errors.append(
+                    f"inkling_mtp_swa_num_attention_heads={heads} must be a multiple of "
+                    f"inkling_swa_num_query_groups={groups} and of TP={self.tensor_model_parallel_size}"
+                )
+        if self.inkling_mtp_chain_hidden_post_norm:
+            errors.append("inkling_mtp_chain_hidden_post_norm=True is not ported (the checkpoints use False)")
+        if getattr(self, "mtp_use_repeated_layer", False):
+            errors.append(
+                "mtp_use_repeated_layer is not supported: every Inkling MTP depth has its own block"
+            )
+        if getattr(self, "mtp_hybrid_override_pattern", None):
+            errors.append("mtp_hybrid_override_pattern is not supported by Inkling")
+        if self.pipeline_model_parallel_layout is not None:
+            errors.append(
+                "a custom pipeline_model_parallel_layout is not supported with Inkling MTP: the MTP "
+                "depths run on the last pipeline stage, after the last decoder layer"
+            )
+        return errors

+###############################################################################

+
+"""Inkling dense SwiGLU MLP (HF ``InklingMLP``; used by the multi-token-prediction blocks).
+
+``down(silu(gate(x)) * up(x)) * global_scale``: no biases, and a learned scalar
+``global_scale`` (HF ``use_global_scale``).
+
+Built on Megatron's :class:`~megatron.core.transformer.mlp.MLP`, so it inherits the backend's
+tensor parallelism and checkpoint layout:
+
+* ``linear_fc1`` is a ColumnParallelLinear of width ``2F``. Each TP rank holds
+  ``cat(gate_shard, up_shard)`` (stride 2), and the sharded state dict splits gate / up so a
+  checkpoint reshards across TP sizes.
+* ``linear_fc2`` is a RowParallelLinear (``F -> H``) that all-reduces the output over TP.
+
+The HF checkpoint stores gate and up interleaved in ``w13_dn`` (even rows gate, odd rows up).
+The converter de-interleaves them into ``linear_fc1.weight = cat(gate, up)``.
+
+The differences from the base class are deliberate:
+
+* Width: the base reads ``config.ffn_hidden_size`` for ``linear_fc2``. For Inkling that is the
+  MoE expert width, so the MLP is built on a shallow config copy whose ``ffn_hidden_size`` is
+  ``inkling_dense_intermediate_size``.
+* Precision: ``forward`` computes the SwiGLU in fp32 and casts back, as SGLang's ``swiglu``.
+  The GEMMs stay in the activation dtype. ``global_scale`` multiplies the ``linear_fc2``
+  output (after its TP all-reduce).
+* Init: the weights are drawn from a CPU generator seeded per (layer, slot), on the full
+  ``[2F, H]`` / ``[H, F]`` tensors, and each TP rank copies its own slice. This makes the
+  initial model the same for every parallel layout, as the rest of the Inkling port.
+* Checkpoint: ``global_scale`` is a TP-replicated parameter. The base sharded state dict only
+  visits submodules, so it is added here.
+"""
+
+import copy
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+from megatron.core.transformer.mlp import MLP, MLPSubmodules
+from megatron.core.transformer.utils import (
+    ensure_metadata_has_dp_cp_group,
+    make_sharded_tensors_for_checkpoint,
+)
+from megatron.core.utils import get_pg_rank, get_pg_size
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.inkling.inkling_layers import (
+    init_seed,
+    seeded_normal,
+)
+
+
+def _swiglu_fp32(gate_up):
+    """SwiGLU over the local ``cat(gate, up)`` columns, computed in fp32 (SGLang's ``swiglu``)."""
+    gate, up = gate_up.float().chunk(2, dim=-1)
+    return (F.silu(gate) * up).to(gate_up.dtype)
+
+
+class InklingDenseMLP(MLP):
+    """Dense SwiGLU MLP with a learned output scale, on Megatron's MLP (module docstring).
+
+    ``forward`` returns ``(out, None)``, Megatron's ``(output, bias)`` convention. With
+    selective recompute, the module ``mlp`` recomputes the whole MLP. ``moe_act`` is ignored
+    here, because it names the routed experts' SwiGLU."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config, inkling_layer_idx, ffn_hidden_size=None, tp_group=None):
+        F_ = int(ffn_hidden_size or config.inkling_dense_intermediate_size)
+        if not config.gated_linear_unit or config.add_bias_linear:
+            raise ValueError("InklingDenseMLP: requires a gated linear unit (swiglu) without biases")
+        mlp_config = copy.copy(config)  # only the MLP sees the dense width (module docstring)
+        mlp_config.ffn_hidden_size = F_
+        super().__init__(
+            config=mlp_config,
+            submodules=MLPSubmodules(
+                linear_fc1=tensor_parallel.ColumnParallelLinear,
+                linear_fc2=tensor_parallel.RowParallelLinear,
+            ),
+            ffn_hidden_size=F_,
+            tp_group=tp_group,
+        )
+        self.ffn_hidden_size = F_
+        H = config.hidden_size
+        if config.perform_initialization:
+            std, base = config.init_method_std, config.inkling_init_seed
+            gate_up = seeded_normal(
+                (2 * F_, H), std, init_seed(base, inkling_layer_idx, "dense_gate_up_proj")
+            )
+            down = seeded_normal((H, F_), std, init_seed(base, inkling_layer_idx, "dense_down_proj"))
+            tp, rank = get_pg_size(self.tp_group), get_pg_rank(self.tp_group)
+            part = F_ // tp
+            rows = slice(rank * part, (rank + 1) * part)
+            gate, up = gate_up.chunk(2, 0)
+            with torch.no_grad():
+                self.linear_fc1.weight.copy_(torch.cat((gate[rows], up[rows]), 0))
+                self.linear_fc2.weight.copy_(down[:, rows])
+        self.use_global_scale = bool(config.inkling_dense_use_global_scale)
+        if self.use_global_scale:
+            self.global_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))
+        selective = config.recompute_granularity == "selective"
+        self.recompute = selective and "mlp" in (config.recompute_modules or [])
+
+    def _forward(self, x):
+        h, _ = self.linear_fc1(x)
+        out, _ = self.linear_fc2(_swiglu_fp32(h))
+        if self.use_global_scale:
+            out = out * self.global_scale.to(out.dtype)
+        return out
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, *_args, padding_mask=None, **_kwargs):
+        del padding_mask  # a dense MLP routes nothing: every token is processed
+        if self.recompute and self.training and hidden_states.requires_grad:
+            return tensor_parallel.checkpoint(self._forward, False, hidden_states), None
+        return self._forward(hidden_states), None
+
+    def sharded_state_dict(self, prefix="", sharded_offsets=(), metadata=None):
+        """The base's (TP-sharded fc1 / fc2, with gate / up split), plus the TP-replicated
+        ``global_scale``."""
+        sd = super().sharded_state_dict(prefix, sharded_offsets, metadata)
+        if self.use_global_scale:
+            metadata = ensure_metadata_has_dp_cp_group(metadata)
+            sd.update(
+                make_sharded_tensors_for_checkpoint(
+                    {"global_scale": self.global_scale},
+                    prefix,
+                    {},
+                    sharded_offsets,
+                    tp_group=self.tp_group,
+                    dp_cp_group=metadata["dp_cp_group"],
+                )
+            )
+        return sd

+###############################################################################

+
+"""Inkling building blocks: RMSNorm, the causal short convolution and the
+relative-bias / log-scaled attention. Tensors are sequence-first ``[s, b, h]``.
+
+Tensor parallelism splits the attention heads (q/k/v/r column-parallel, o
+row-parallel); the k/v short convolutions are depthwise, so they split with their
+channels (TP axis 0 in the distributed checkpoint). Per-head parameters that every
+rank applies to its own heads (q/k norms, the relative-logit table) are replicated
+and their gradients summed over TP through ``copy_to_tensor_model_parallel_region``.
+
+Precision: under bf16 / fp16 training ``Float16Module`` stores every parameter in
+the training dtype (Megatron has no keep-in-fp32 mechanism for parameters); the
+optimizer's fp32 main parameters hold the master copy. The short convolutions,
+the norms and the softmax compute in fp32 (HF keeps the sconvs in fp32).
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.mappings import copy_to_tensor_model_parallel_region
+from megatron.core.transformer.attention import Attention, SelfAttentionSubmodules
+from megatron.core.transformer.enums import AttnMaskType
+from megatron.core.transformer.identity_op import IdentityOp
+from megatron.core.transformer.utils import (
+    ensure_metadata_has_dp_cp_group,
+    make_sharded_tensors_for_checkpoint,
+)
+from megatron.core.utils import divide
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.inkling.inkling_relpos_attention import (
+    relpos_flash_attention,
+)
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.v4_attention_kernels._triton_common.rmsnorm import (
+    fused_rms_norm,
+)
+
+# Query rows per block of the eager attention. Without autograd (eval, scoring) this bounds
+# the live score / bias memory to [b, n, ATTN_QUERY_CHUNK, keys] (keys = q1 - k0: at most
+# window + ATTN_QUERY_CHUNK - 1 on sliding layers, up to the sequence length on global ones). In training every block's probabilities stay saved for backward, so the global layers
+# still keep O(b * n * s * s) activations unless core-attention recompute is on.
+ATTN_QUERY_CHUNK = 1024
+
+
+# Hex digits of the SHA-256 digest kept as the seed: 15 digits = 60 bits, which fits
+# torch.Generator.manual_seed (it takes any 64-bit value) and leaves collisions negligible. The
+# value is fixed because changing it changes every Inkling init.
+INIT_SEED_HEX_DIGITS = 15
+
+
+def init_seed(base, layer, slot, index=0):
+    """A deterministic seed for (base seed, 0-based layer, parameter slot, expert index): a SHA-256
+    digest truncated to INIT_SEED_HEX_DIGITS (15 hex digits, 60 bits) so it fits
+    torch.Generator.manual_seed; collisions are negligible."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(f"inkling/{base}/{layer}/{slot}/{index}".encode()).hexdigest()
+    return int(digest[:INIT_SEED_HEX_DIGITS], 16)
+
+
+def seeded_normal(shape, std, seed):
+    """A layout-independent init: the same values on every rank and layout (CPU generator)."""
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(int(seed))
+    return torch.randn(shape, generator=g) * std
+
+
+def _tp_size(tp_group):
+    return 1 if tp_group is None else tp_group.size()
+
+
+def _replicated_for_heads(param, tp_group):
+    """A replicated parameter applied to this rank's heads only: identity forward, grad all-reduce."""
+    if _tp_size(tp_group) == 1:
+        return param
+    return copy_to_tensor_model_parallel_region(param, group=tp_group)
+
+
+class InklingRMSNorm(torch.nn.RMSNorm):
+    """torch's RMSNorm parameters (Megatron's ``WrappedTorchNorm`` RMSNorm) computed by the
+    shared Primus RMSNorm kernel (``fused_rms_norm``, as ``LocalRMSNorm``) with the HF
+    rounding: normalize in fp32, cast back to the input dtype (``mid_cast=True``), then scale
+    by ``weight``. With ``weight`` in the input dtype, the product of two bf16 / fp16 values is
+    exact in fp32, so the result matches HF's ``weight * h.to(dtype)`` up to the fp32 order of
+    the mean reduction. Off CUDA (or with ``PRIMUS_RMSNORM_TRITON=0``) the eager reference runs.
+
+    ``config`` is accepted (and unused) because ``TransformerBlock`` builds its final
+    norm as ``layer_norm(config=, hidden_size=, eps=)``. ``tp_group`` marks a norm
+    that is replicated across TP but applied to this rank's heads only (the per-head
+    q / k norms): its gradient is then summed over TP.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size, eps=1e-6, config=None, tp_group=None):
+        del config  # see the class docstring
+        super().__init__(hidden_size, eps=eps, elementwise_affine=True)
+        self.tp_group = tp_group
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        weight = _replicated_for_heads(self.weight, self.tp_group)
+        return fused_rms_norm(x, weight, eps=self.eps, mid_cast=True)
+
+
+SCONV_IMPLS = ("auto", "eager", "causal_conv1d")
+"""``inkling_sconv_impl`` values. ``causal_conv1d`` requires Dao's ``causal_conv1d_fn`` to import
+(else the layer refuses to build) and uses it for every input the kernel supports: a GPU input,
+kernel size 2..4, sequence length >= 2 and a channel count divisible by 8; other inputs run the
+eager reference. ``auto`` is the same, but runs eager also when the kernel does not import.
+``eager`` always runs the fp32 ``F.conv1d`` reference. Inkling's short convs (kernel 4, 8-aligned
+channels) meet the shape conditions."""
+
+_CAUSAL_CONV1D = None  # the imported causal_conv1d_fn, False when it does not import
+
+
+def causal_conv1d_kernel():
+    """Dao's ``causal_conv1d_fn`` (ROCm build in the Primus image), or ``None`` if it does not import."""
+    global _CAUSAL_CONV1D
+    if _CAUSAL_CONV1D is None:
+        try:
+            from causal_conv1d import causal_conv1d_fn
+
+            _CAUSAL_CONV1D = causal_conv1d_fn
+        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  (any import failure means: no fused kernel)
+            _CAUSAL_CONV1D = False
+    return _CAUSAL_CONV1D or None
+
+
+def eager_causal_conv1d(x, weight, seq_idx=None):
+    """Reference depthwise causal conv: ``x [b, c, s]`` (fp32), ``weight [c, k]`` -> ``[b, c, s]``.
+
+    ``seq_idx [b, s]`` (int, optional) is the document id of each position (packed sequences): a
+    position sees only earlier positions of its own document, as ``causal_conv1d_fn`` with
+    ``seq_idx``. Without it, this is the plain ``F.conv1d`` with left padding."""
+    k, s = weight.shape[-1], x.shape[-1]
+    if seq_idx is None:
+        return F.conv1d(x, weight.unsqueeze(1), padding=k - 1, groups=x.shape[1])[..., :s]
+    y = x * weight[:, k - 1 : k]
+    for d in range(1, min(k, s)):  # tap k-1-d reads the input d steps back
+        same = (seq_idx[:, d:] == seq_idx[:, :-d]).unsqueeze(1)  # [b, 1, s - d]
+        shifted = F.pad(x[..., :-d] * same, (d, 0))
+        y = y + shifted * weight[:, k - 1 - d : k - d]
+    return y
+
+
+class InklingShortConv(torch.nn.Module):
+    """Causal depthwise conv over the sequence plus a residual, computed in fp32.
+
+    ``weight`` is ``[channels, kernel]`` (the checkpoint's ``[c, 1, k]`` squeezed) and
+    starts at zero (the identity map), as in HF. ``tp_sharded`` marks a convolution
+    whose channels are split over TP (the k / v convs): its distributed-checkpoint
+    tensor is then TP-sharded along axis 0.
+
+    ``impl`` (``inkling_sconv_impl``, see ``SCONV_IMPLS``) picks Dao's fused
+    ``causal_conv1d_fn`` (forward and backward, fp32, channel-last view of the
+    ``[s, b, c]`` input, no copy) or the eager ``F.conv1d`` reference; the two are
+    numerically close (within test tolerances), not bit-identical. The model refuses packed
+    sequences, so the layer takes no document ids; ``eager_causal_conv1d`` and the fused kernel
+    both accept ``seq_idx`` for when packing is enabled.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, channels, kernel_size, tp_sharded=False, tp_group=None, impl="eager"):
+        super().__init__()
+        if impl not in SCONV_IMPLS:
+            raise ValueError(f"inkling_sconv_impl={impl!r} must be one of {SCONV_IMPLS}")
+        if impl == "causal_conv1d" and causal_conv1d_kernel() is None:
+            raise ImportError(
+                "inkling_sconv_impl=causal_conv1d needs the causal_conv1d package (causal_conv1d_fn), "
+                "which does not import; set inkling_sconv_impl: auto (fused when available) or eager"
+            )
+        self.kernel_size = kernel_size
+        self.tp_sharded = tp_sharded
+        self.tp_group = tp_group
+        self.impl = impl
+        self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(channels, kernel_size))
+        if tp_sharded:
+            tensor_parallel.set_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(self.weight, True, 0, 1)
+
+    def _use_kernel(self, h):
+        if self.impl == "eager" or not h.is_cuda:
+            return False
+        # causal_conv1d_fn supports widths 2..4; its channel-last backward needs s >= 2 and
+        # 8-aligned strides (channels and batch * channels).
+        # (impl causal_conv1d: __init__ refused a missing kernel, so the import check holds.)
+        ok = 2 <= self.kernel_size <= 4 and h.shape[0] >= 2 and h.shape[-1] % 8 == 0
+        return ok and causal_conv1d_kernel() is not None
+
+    def forward(self, x):  # x: [s, b, c]
+        dtype = x.dtype
+        h = x.float().contiguous()
+        w = self.weight.float()
+        xt = h.permute(1, 2, 0)  # [b, c, s]: a channel-last view (stride 1 on c)
+        if self._use_kernel(h):
+            y = causal_conv1d_kernel()(xt, w, None, activation=None)
+        else:
+            y = eager_causal_conv1d(xt, w)
+        return (y.permute(2, 0, 1) + h).to(dtype)
+
+    def sharded_state_dict(self, prefix="", sharded_offsets=(), metadata=None):
+        metadata = ensure_metadata_has_dp_cp_group(metadata)
+        return make_sharded_tensors_for_checkpoint(
+            self.state_dict(prefix="", keep_vars=True),
+            prefix,
+            {"weight": 0} if self.tp_sharded else {},
+            sharded_offsets,
+            tp_group=self.tp_group,
+            dp_cp_group=metadata["dp_cp_group"],
+        )
+
+
+def relative_bias(rel_logits, q_start, k_start):
+    """Bias of queries ``q_start + i`` over keys ``k_start ..`` (up to the last query) from
